name: Post Matric Scholarship (RTF + MTF) for BC and EBC students - Telangana ePASS
provider: BC Welfare Department, Government of Telangana (via ePASS)

rules.quote:
BC & EBC and Minority Welfare Students who belongs to rural area their
 family income should be Rs. One Lakh Fifty Thousand or below.

BC & EBC and Minority Welfare Students who are belongs to Urban area 
 family income should be Rs. Two Lakhs or below.

BC & EBC and Minority Welfare Students who belongs to rural area their
 family income should be Rs. One Lakh Fifty Thousand or below.

rules.value: EBC not eligible for Intermediate except Corporate College Admissions Scheme; no open university/distance/category B MBBS-BDS
rules.quote:
Students of BC, EBC and DW students studying the Courses offered
 by open universities, distant mode, category B seats in MBBS,
 BDS.

Level of study
 EBC/Minority/Disabled as on 1st July of the Academic Year
 SC,ST & BC as on 1st July of the Academic Year

amount.text: RTF paid to college plus MTF per month: Group I/II Rs 1500 (CAH)/650 (DS); Group III Rs 1000/500; Group IV Rs 750/500
amount.quote: The fee reimbursed generally ranges from Rs.850/-for Intermediate course to Rs 6.90 lakhs for Medical courses per annum per student.

deadline.text: Not stated on scheme pages; apply on ePASS
